text:
elaine: Quick PSA — tiny hailstorm near SoMa, SFMTA just put a shuttle substitution on 29X between 4th & Bryant -> Caltrain. If you're headed south, consider leaving a bit earlier. 🚧🌨️

james: Ugh, thanks. I'm on an ebike—probably gonna melt into a soggy burrito. Anyone know if the shuttle takes bikes?

marco: @james nope, shuttles usually say 'no bikes' on the bus notice. I locked mine at the Bryant lot. :crying_face:

transit-bot: SFMTA ALERT: Route 29X operating on shuttle buses between 4th & Brannan and 22nd St Caltrain due to road clearing. ETA delays ~12–20 min. https://status.sfmta.org/alerts/29x-shuttle

tara: I'm in a carpool from the Marina — roads fine up here but lots of fog. If anyone needs a lift from downtown between 5:15–5:45PM ping me. :)

devon: Poll: how are you getting home? React with one of these in 15m — :bike:, :oncoming_bus:, :car:, :walking:. I'm :oncoming_bus: (stuck in the shuttle line).

elaine: FYI for downtown folks — the 4th & Bryant shelter is slammed. If you're waiting, try the little awning by the coffee shop two blocks over. No guarantees tho.

james: @devon react :bike: even though i'm soggy. Also pro tip: stash a cheap packable poncho in your backpack. Saved me last week.

marco: If you're using Muni app, toggle "vehicle crowding" to avoid the packed shuttles. It helped me earlier.

tara: Also — office plants in the lounge survived my improvised umbrella fort. :seedling: Thanks micro-architects.

devon: LOL @tara. Update: 3 :bike:, 4 :oncoming_bus:, 2 :car:, 1 :walking. Looks like shuttle is winning.

elaine: Quick command for anyone curious — `curl https://status.sfmta.org/29x | jq .delays` (not exact endpoint, just joking) :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:

transit-bot: Reminder: if you're going to be late to a standup or duty, add a message in #eng-oncall. Ops teams are watching for delays.

james: Thanks for the heads-up everyone — heading out early. Stay dry and for the love of hoodies, zip up the zippers so the hail doesn't sneak in. :sweat_smile:

marco: See y'all tomorrow — unless the hail decides to unionize. :snowflake::raised_hands:
